changes.content: VerificationOutcomeNotifier — handle(event) with a DedupStore lookup on (producer_id, fbo_number, verified_on) before any send. TemplateRenderer — renders from the event payload only; has no read path to identity_schema, which would breach DAT-1.b.

Duplicate delivery -> DedupStore hit, no send, acknowledged. Render failure -> dead-letter with the named owner, never discarded: the verification really happened, and a dropped evidence-derived notification is a producer who was never told their livelihood is blocked. Mail transport failure -> bounded retry, then dead-letter. No replay path exists — the source event is Evidence kind and a replay would re-assert the fact.
